scenarios.title: Per-second accrual
scenarios.result: balance after N days of per-second compounding
scenarios.why: How Maker's jug and pot accrue: the rate per second, compounded every second, N days at a time. The rate is 1.6e-9 at 5% APR, which an 18-decimal grid holds to ten digits before any arithmetic; FP127 computes the power as one exact integer power (compound), the WAD and 64.64 libraries as exp(n ln(1 + r)), Maker as rpow.

scenarios.title: Continuous accrual
scenarios.result: balance after N days of continuous accrual
scenarios.why: How Aave and Morpho accrue: the ideal is e^(rate * time), and both ship a three-term expansion of it (1 + x + x^2/2 + x^3/6), which Aave notes 'slightly underpays liquidity providers and undercharges borrowers'. Every library is judged against the exponential it approximates. The step here is one accrual spanning N days, which is what a market that nobody touched for N days computes on its next interaction; the expansion's error is x^4/24 with x = rate * years, so it is invisible at daily updates and the whole story at a year or more. Morpho holds the rate per second in WAD (1,585,489,599 wei at 5% APR), ten significant digits before any arithmetic; both digit counts show that loss, since the format truth is built from the annual rate the other libraries receive.

scenarios.title: An option walking out of the money
scenarios.step: S = S (1 - tick); then C = S N(d1) - K e^(-rT) N(d2)
scenarios.result: the Black-Scholes call price after N down-ticks of the spot
scenarios.why: Options protocols price with N(d), the normal distribution function, and the spot walks. Near the money every library agrees; past d = -8 an 18-decimal N(d) is zero and the price with it, and before that e^(-d^2/2) has lost most of its digits. FP127 has normCdf as an op; the other libraries run the same series and continued fraction through their own exp, sqrt, mul and div, with pi by Ramanujan through the same ops, so each is judged on its primitives.

solady: normCdf by the series/fraction through these

scenarios.title: Decay, the share released
scenarios.result: the share released after N steps of decay
scenarios.why: Vesting, TWAP weights and exponential moving averages multiply by e^(-dt/tau) every step. The factor is a hair below one, and on an 18-decimal grid e^(-eps) rounds to a grid point whose distance from one is wrong by up to 1e-18 relative, every step: at eps = 1e-12 that is six digits of the released share, at 1e-15 three, at 1e-18 nothing is released at all.
